expected.rule: SREP 51, Semantics: "The vertices are the same points in both modes". The vertices of the wiggled path (detail 3 per hundred units over 200 units, so one every 40 px from x = 220) are x = 220, 260, 300, 340, ...; at the vertex x = 340 the corner polyline (no mode) and the smooth spline pass through the same point, so the red centroid in the 4 px slab 338..342 has the same height as in the smooth case srep-0051-wiggle-smooth-vertex-340 (cy 216.44). Only cy is asserted: the slab holds the segments on both sides of the vertex, whose slopes differ between the two modes. The claim is the equality of the two cases; the value is the engine-seeded noise of seed 7 (a regression pin shared with the smooth case). Not yet measured on the engine.
